'''Sulfur mynocks''' were a subspecies of the parasitic [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] that lived on the arid [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. Contrary to regular mynocks, the sulfur mynocks lived in an atmosphere and had two horns on their head. Variants included the Riverside sulfur mynock and Sulfur pool mynock.<ref name="SWG" />
